Your own supper is cold bread.|The brew behaves for you. {mate} comes back, sniffs, and says your wrist is better than {theirs}. Your stomach disagrees with the praise.} Sorry, I've plans {You go to supper. {mate} goes to supper late, and the brew turns slightly orange in revenge.|You make your excuses. {mate} finds someone else, and mentions it, twice.|You say no this time. {mate} looks at the spoon, then at you, and sighs the sigh of the betrayed.}
